description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Manifold Key enters.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
